svg.text: React 19 SPA simulating Singapore's InvoiceNow (Peppol) e-invoicing · NTU AI Engineering Module 2 · no backend of its own

g.text: Browser — EasyInvoice SPA · React 19 · Vite 8 · Tailwind 4 · React Router 7
pages: Login · Tour · Dashboard · Create · Edit · Customers · Products
shell: AppShell · Navbar · RequireAuth · Toast · ErrorBanner · Hint
form: customer / product pickers · line items · 9% GST · validation
AuthContext — SHA-256 login gate · session in sessionStorage (ends with tab)
useInvoices — useReducer store · UI updates only after the API confirms
useFetch — generic abortable loader (FX rates, reference data)
roles.can(user, action, invoice) — single source of permission truth
toast + hints toggle owned by AppShell, passed down as props
API layer — src/api/ (plain fetch, no libraries)
client.js — base = VITE_MOCKAPI_URL · throws on non-2xx · 204 → null
invoices.js — GET list / one · POST · PUT · DELETE → /invoices
free APIs hit directly: Frankfurter FX · randomuser contacts
every fn takes AbortSignal; writes resolve to the saved record
offline (no URL): reads fall back to public/api/*.json
invoice.js — GST 9% totals · INV-YYYY-NNN · SGD format · overdue
constants.js — UEN regex · status enum · FX / contact URLs · GST rate
hash.js — SHA-256 via WebCrypto · users.js — 4 demo accounts
roles.js — VIEW_ONLY vs EDIT action matrix
No own backend — the Peppol "Access Point" is simulated in-browser:
status → Queued, 900 ms delay, then UEN validity → Transmitted | Failed.
shared JSON storage — visible to every browser
no auth — the URL is public, not a secret
all CRUD + status writes persist here
writes rejected with a clear message
live ECB rates: 1 SGD → USD, EUR, MYR, JPY, CNY
no key · CORS enabled · feeds the FX card
The Peppol Access Point is not a real service —
transmission is simulated client-side; no invoice
npm test — Vitest 5 + Testing Library + jsdom
npm run build — Vite 8 + Tailwind 4 → dist/
runs on every pull request and push to main
postbuild.mjs — index.html per route (plain static hosts)
deploy.ps1 — build + mirror to site / NAS
/tour — React concepts with real code snippets
PR template · CODEOWNERS · docs map in-repo
API contract — documented schema · MockAPI validates nothing; these shapes are the de-facto contract enforced client-side
client.js: throws a readable Error on any non-2xx; 204 resolves to null.
Every call accepts an AbortSignal; writes resolve to the saved record.
writes → rejected with a clear "offline demo data" error
dashboard shows an offline banner; no fake success
Invoice lifecycle — simulated state machine (useInvoices) · transmit = PUT Queued, 900 ms delay, then UEN validity decides the outcome
edit · transmit — Draft or Failed only
same can() call drives UI buttons and route guards — one source of truth
